what_its_for: This medicine is used to treat adults with generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), a condition that causes muscle weakness, and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP), a condition that causes weakness and numbness in the arms and legs. It works by reducing certain proteins in your blood called IgG antibodies that are causing your immune system to attack your own body.
how_to_take: This medicine is given as a shot under the skin (subcutaneous injection), usually in the stomach (abdomen) or thigh. A healthcare provider will give you the injection in a clinic or doctor's office. Each injection takes about 30 to 90 seconds. You will be watched for at least 30 minutes after each injection for any reactions. Do not try to inject this medicine yourself at home unless your doctor specifically trains and approves you to do so.
dosing: For myasthenia gravis (gMG): The usual dose is 1,000 mg given once a week for 4 weeks. This 4-week cycle may be repeated if your symptoms return or your doctor decides you need another course. For CIDP: You will start with a loading phase of 1,000 mg once a week for 3 weeks, then move to a maintenance dose of 1,000 mg every 2 weeks or 2,000 mg every 4 weeks, depending on how you respond. Your doctor will decide the best dose and schedule for you.
missed_dose: If you miss a scheduled injection appointment, contact your doctor or clinic as soon as possible to reschedule. Try not to miss your appointments, as staying on schedule helps the medicine work its best. Do not try to double up doses to make up for a missed one.
storage: This medicine is stored and prepared by your healthcare provider or pharmacist. If you are given prefilled syringes to use at home, store them in the refrigerator at 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C). Keep them in the original carton to protect from light. Do not freeze. Do not shake. If needed, you may keep the medicine at room temperature (up to 77°F or 25°C) for up to 8 weeks. Once kept at room temperature, do not put it back in the refrigerator. Keep all medicines out of reach of children.
what_to_avoid: Avoid receiving live vaccines (such as MMR, chickenpox, or live flu vaccine) while on this medicine, as it lowers certain antibodies and may make vaccines less effective or cause infection. Tell all your doctors and pharmacists you are on this medicine before getting any vaccines. Avoid close contact with people who have active infections. Let your doctor know right away if you are exposed to someone with a serious illness.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor or seek emergency help right away if you experience: serious allergic reactions such as hives, swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, trouble breathing, or feeling faint; severe redness, swelling, or pain at the injection site; signs of infection such as fever, chills, cough, or feeling very unwell; unusual bruising or bleeding; dizziness or fainting. Also call your doctor if your symptoms are not improving or are getting worse, or if you have any new or unusual side effects.
when_it_works: Some patients start to feel improvement in their muscle strength or nerve symptoms within the first 1 to 2 weeks of starting treatment. Most people see the greatest benefit by the end of the 4-week treatment cycle. Results vary from person to person. Talk to your doctor if you do not notice any improvement after completing a full treatment cycle.
special_populations: Pregnancy and breastfeeding: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. This medicine may pass through the placenta and could affect an unborn baby's immune system. The risks and benefits should be carefully discussed with your doctor. Elderly patients (65 years and older): No dose adjustment is generally needed, but older patients should be monitored closely. Kidney or liver problems: No dose adjustments are currently required based on kidney or liver function, but tell your doctor about all your medical conditions. Children: This medicine is not currently approved for use in patients under 18 years of age.
